objective: Evaluate the production options_desk selector and four priced option structures with non-overlapping, point-in-time parametric trades.

hypotheses.short_put_csp: Rich variance risk premium during calm, low-magnitude regimes produces positive net expiry PnL for a 30-delta cash-secured put.
hypotheses.short_put_spread: The same premium-selling regime produces positive net expiry PnL for the fixed-width defined-risk put spread.
hypotheses.jade_lizard: The same premium-selling regime produces positive net expiry PnL when the no-upside-risk credit invariant is feasible.
hypotheses.long_vol_straddle: An out-of-sample surprise-eruption prediction from calm, when VRP is not rich, produces positive net expiry PnL for an ATM straddle.

production_policy.expiry: nearest monthly third Friday in the production window
production_policy.entry_information: prior-session SPY/VIX and cross-asset data available before the following session open
production_policy.selector: desk.strategies.select with the production VRP, magnitude, calm, eruption, and term-structure rules
production_policy.overlap: one open trade at a time per strategy; the next entry must follow the prior expiry
production_policy.exit_price: intrinsic value at expiry using unadjusted SPY close; preceding session on market holiday

signal_replay.vrp_and_magnitude: trailing-only calculations from qlib_lab CSV data
signal_replay.surprise_model: macro_gpu_lab feature and label functions with expanding walk-forward predictions and a horizon-length label gap
signal_replay.missing_data: date is ineligible; never impute a trade signal

gate.pass_rule: Deflated Sharpe ratio > 0 and PBO < 0.5 for the production-expiry PnL series
gate.minimum_effective_sample: Canonical gate requirements apply; fewer than 40 completed trades cannot clear PBO.
gate.promotion_effect: Display-only per-strategy gate badge. The desk remains advisory and SHADOW; no execution or sizing change.

non_gate_diagnostics.vix_iv_pairs: Report selector tilt counts only because this candidate has no defined legs or standalone payoff.
non_gate_diagnostics.entry_ledger: Persist dates, structures, premiums, terminal values, costs, and PnL for auditability.
